plan.title: SvelteKit Params Warning Suppression Implementation Plan

overview.description: Enhance the existing SvelteKit params warning suppression in svelte.config.js to ensure comprehensive coverage of all SvelteKit internal props and improve pattern matching reliability. The current implementation (v3.7.2) already addresses the core issue, but this plan provides additional robustness and future-proofing.

change.description: Enhance regex patterns with more comprehensive matching
change.code_before: const propMatch = warning.message.match(/Page was created with unknown prop '([^']+)'/) || warning.message.match(/Component was created with unknown prop '([^']+)'/) || warning.message.match(/'([^']+)' was exported/) || warning.message.match(/Unknown prop '([^']+)'/);
change.code_after: const propMatch = warning.message.match(/Page was created with unknown prop '([^']+)'/) || warning.message.match(/Component was created with unknown prop '([^']+)'/) || warning.message.match(/'([^']+)' was exported/) || warning.message.match(/Unknown prop '([^']+)'/) || warning.message.match(/received an unexpected slot "([^"]+)"/) || warning.message.match(/\<[^>]+\> was created with unknown prop '([^']+)'/);
